visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a black ribbed crop top and a short black skirt, stands on an urban street. She smiles brightly at the camera, touching her hair with her right hand while holding a smartphone in her left. Behind her are several parked scooters and a textured grey brick wall with large air conditioning units mounted above. The lighting is natural and even. (2) The scene shifts slightly as the woman holds her smartphone closer to the lens, displaying a map interface on the screen. She points her finger toward a direction off-camera to her right, maintaining a playful and energetic facial expression with an open-mouthed smile. The background remains consistent with the street and parked motorcycles under soft daylight. (3) The visual transitions to a vertical screen recording of a mobile application named "跑咖咖." The map initially shows a wide view of Taiwan with numerous red coffee cup icons. As the interface zooms into the Taipei city area, various filter menus appear at the bottom, allowing adjustments for price ranges, power outlet availability, and operating hours. (4) The camera returns to the woman, now standing in front of a modern glass-fronted building which appears to be a car dealership with vehicles visible inside. She engages in an expressive conversation, using large hand gestures and changing her facial expressions from surprised to confident. She eventually leans in close to the camera to whisper, shielding her mouth with her hand. (5) The woman suddenly turns around and begins to run down a wet pavement sidewalk alongside a road. She looks back over her shoulder multiple times, laughing and waving her arms in an exaggerated, playful manner. The camera follows her movement in a handheld tracking shot, capturing the urban street environment with buildings and street signs in the background.
